targets.expected_type:
∀ {d n : ℕ} (c : MaxoutProductDAG d n) (K D : ℕ)
(hc : c.BoundedRankDegree K D),
∃ g : SplitDAG d n,
g.maxoutRank≤2 ∧ g.graphSize≤(24*2^(max K D)*(4*K+2*D+1))*c.graphSize ∧
(∀ x : Fin d × Bool → ℝ, (g.eval x).1-(g.eval x).2=
  c.eval (fun i => x (i,false)-x (i,true))) ∧
(∀ x : Fin d × Bool → ℝ, 0≤x → 0≤g.eval x) ∧
(∀ x y : Fin d × Bool → ℝ, 0≤x → 0≤y → x≤y → g.eval x≤g.eval y) ∧
(∀ i : Fin n, ∃ P Q : MaxPolynomial (Fin d × Bool),
  ∀ x : Fin d × Bool → ℝ, 0≤x → (g.eval x).1 i=P.eval x ∧ (g.eval x).2 i=Q.eval x)
targets.scope: Complete fixed-rank/bounded-total-multiplication-degree theorem for actual source Maxout/product DAGs. Source graphSize counts neurons plus each incoming vector-weight arc once. Constructed split DAG has maximum maxout arity two, explicit linear size constant depending only on K,D, exact all-node recovery, positivity, monotonicity and finite positive-polynomial maxima. Hypotheses bound actual gate rank and sum of natural exponents, not compiled size.
The actual binomial expansion count ∏(power+1) bounds total multiplication degree; proved from sum(power)+1≤product(power+1). Maxout gates have degree/count zero for this purpose.
